For Sale

7304 Hartnell DR

7304 Hartnell DR, Austin, TX 78723

$525,000

Freshly updated and move-in ready, this 1,923-square-foot single-story home in University Hills blends classic Austin character with clean, modern finishes and generous indoor-outdoor living. Step inside to find warm wood-look plank flooring, fresh neutral tones, recessed lighting, ceiling fans, and abundant natural light throughout. The living and dining area makes an immediate impression with its vaulted, exposed-beam ceiling and striking painted brick fireplace, creating a distinctive gathering space with plenty of character. The refreshed kitchen features quartz countertops, subway tile backsplash, updated cabinetry, stainless steel appliances, and expansive windows overlooking the backyard. Comfortable bedrooms and updated bathrooms provide plenty of flexibility for everyday living, guests, or a home office. Out back, a spacious private yard surrounded by wood fencing and mature trees offers plenty of room to relax, entertain, or garden, while the covered patio and detached storage shed add everyday functionality. Conveniently located near Mueller with easy access to US-183, I-35, parks, shopping, dining, and everything Central and East Austin have to offer, this University Hills home delivers space, character, and an excellent Austin location.
